classifications.rationale: The President describes an internal executive-management direction requiring Federal agencies to adopt workplace policies; the consequence occurs through agency implementation rather than through a present change in legal rights.
classifications.evidence: I directed all Federal agencies to adopt domestic violence workplace policies

classifications.rationale: The President makes a commemorative proclamation and a hortatory appeal to the public, neither of which governs agencies or changes legal rights.
classifications.evidence: do hereby proclaim October 2016 as National Domestic Violence Awareness Month
